description.p:
A simple document converter written in Crystal with GTK4 and libadwaita.
It is based on ImageMagick and can convert between various document formats. It is designed to be simple and easy to use to convert documents for digital storage or sharing.
Simplify conversion modes and apply mode-specific defaults.

ul.li: Remove the separate grayscale-quality mode from the interface and translations.
Use 140 dpi and quality 50 for color, and 170 dpi and quality 40 for grayscale.
Use JPEG compression for grayscale so its quality setting takes effect.
Keep monochrome defaults at 300 dpi, quality 75 and threshold 66.
Synchronize sliders and conversion settings when changing modes.

description.p: Portable Linux packages and improved desktop integration.

ul.li: AppImage and Flatpak bundles include ImageMagick 7 and Ghostscript.
Open file arguments and local file URIs in separate document windows.
Forward file-opening requests to an already running application.
Refresh the application icon in the GNOME style.

description.p: Initial beta release with basic features.
